bio.text: Michael Pakko is the Libertarian Party candidate for Arkansas Secretary of State in 2026 and has chaired the Libertarian Party of Arkansas since 2015.
He is chief economist and state economic forecaster at the Arkansas Economic Development Institute at the University of Arkansas at Little Rock, according to his campaign website.

Pakko was born in Kalamazoo, Michigan, earned a bachelor's degree from Michigan State University in 1984 and a Ph.D. from the University of Rochester, and spent 16 years as a research economist at the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis before moving to Arkansas in 2009.
